entries.proposition: Dose given: J4 0.06 mg/mL in drinking water with 1 percent HPbetaCD, estimated 10.2 mg/kg/day, for 10 weeks from 6 weeks of age; the dose is an estimate from assumed water intake and one dose level was tested.
entries.snippet: Thus, the dose of 0.06 mg/ml J4 in drinking water would approximately give an overall dose of 10.2 mg/kg/day for the mice in this study.

entries.proposition: Adult male mice only, 6-12 weeks old; not a developmental window.
entries.snippet: Only male animals (6-week-old to 12-week-old) were used and female mice were not used due to hormonal cycle variability

entries.proposition: The model has normal-appearing white matter by T2 MRI and no apparent MBP difference in white matter; the diffusion MRI differences are what J4 reverses.
entries.snippet: the WM regions did not display any apparent differences in MBP staining when comparing the WT Veh, Tsc2+/– Veh, and Tsc2+/– J4 groups
entries.anchor: Results / J4 enhanced myelin sheath integrity

entries.proposition: Seizures are absent from the model and from the study.
entries.snippet: The Tsc2+/– mice employed in this study display cognitive dysfunction and ASD-like features in the absence of brain hamartomas and spontaneous seizures

entries.proposition: Hyperactivity is measured as cFos-positive cell counts; with J4, retrosplenial cFos fell below the wild-type level, so the treatment did not stop at normalisation.
entries.snippet: whereas cFos levels in Tsc2+/– J4 mice were significantly reduced compared with WT Veh controls (layer II–III, p = 0.0176; layer V, p = 0.0261).
entries.anchor: Results / J4 mitigated the excessive expression of pS6 and cFos

entries.proposition: Group sizes in histology: three animals per group (F(2,6)); the TEM comparison uses N = 3, 3 and 4 animals but regression across individual axons.
entries.snippet: Pairwise linear regression comparisons revealed that WT Veh and Tsc2+/– Veh exhibited similar slopes but significantly different intercepts (F(1, 1215) = 58.06, p < 0.0001)
entries.anchor: Results / J4 enhanced myelin sheath integrity

entries.proposition: Onion-bulb count: 3 animals per group; J4 restores the count to wild-type level.
entries.snippet: Quantification of the number of myelin bulbs observed in the fornix across groups. Bars represent group means with individual data points from different animals.

entries.proposition: Behavioural testing was by investigators aware of group allocation; only analysis was blinded.
entries.snippet: Behavioral testing was performed by investigators aware of group allocation; all behavioral data analyses were conducted by investigators blinded to group identity.

entries.proposition: J4 effects in OPC and OL counts are significant only in the corpus callosum and cingulum, not in cortex; CNPase change is a trend (P = 0.0792).
entries.snippet: J4 treatment showed a trend toward increased CNPase immunoreactivity compared with Tsc2+/– Veh, although this difference did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.0792)

entries.proposition: The authors list limitations: males only, mild model, mechanism of myelin effect unclear, lineage progression not shown, adenosine not measured.
entries.snippet: the direct measurement of adenosine and the downstream molecular pathways through which adenosine receptor signaling influences oligodendroglial maturation are not yet fully defined in this present study

entries.proposition: Normal-brain treated arm: WT mice receiving J4 show a slightly thicker myelin regression (P = 0.0158 in text) while the OFT and NOR show no change; the only measure of J4 in a non-mutant brain.
entries.snippet: while WT J4 group showed a slight increase of myelin thickness when compared to WT Veh controls (F(1, 974) = 1.986, p = 0.0158)
entries.anchor: Results / J4 enhanced myelin sheath integrity

entries.proposition: The same sentence reports F(1, 974) = 1.986 for both a nonsignificant slope comparison (P = 0.1591) and a significant one (P = 0.0158): one F value cannot give two P values at identical degrees of freedom, so one of the two is mis-typed.
entries.snippet: There were no significant changes in the slopes between WT Veh vs. WT J4 groups (F(1, 974) = 1.986, p = 0.1591) (Fig. 4C).
entries.anchor: Results / J4 enhanced myelin sheath integrity
